[[Nicholas the Traveler]] | commonsalvage = 4-5 [[Scale]]s | render = [[File:Vermin Hide.jpg|x150px]] }} [[Vermin Hide]]s are the skinned hides of [[Vermin]], held as [[trophies]]. ==Acquisition== * [[Factions]] ** [[Kaineng City]] *** [[Vermin]] ''Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found [[Talk:Vermin Hide#Drop research|here]].'' ===Farming=== ==== [[Xaquang Skyway]] ==== [[File:Vermin Hide Farming (Xaquang Skyway).jpg|200px]] Start from [[Senji's Corner]] and go west bordering the map, to kill Vermin which [[patrol]] in groups of 3-4. Cross the bridge and [[tank#Cornerblocking|cornerblock]] the several groups with [[Shreader Sharptongue]] inside the dark area, then proceed towards the [[portal]] to [[Wajjun Bazaar]] where you will find another 3 groups (zone in and back to respawn foes). A single [[Signet of Spirits]] [[Spirit spammer|spammer]] player can handle them alone, or any 3-man team (e.g.: [[martial]] attacker, [[minion master]], and [[healer]]). ==Collectors== {{:Yu Lae/Collector}} {{:Bae Kwon/Collector}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|20th December 2010 and 30th December 2013|Xaquang Skyway|3 [[Vermin Hide]]s}} ==Notes== *The collector [[Yu Lae]] trades 5 Vermin Hides for items that sell for 125 {{gold}} to a merchant. This provides a return that is 25% more than just selling the trophies by themselves. *The collector [[Bae Kwon]] trades 3 Vermin Hides for items that are sold by a merchant for 100 {{gold}}. This provides a return that is 67% more than just selling the trophies by themselves. [[Category:Contains scale]] [[Category:Profitable trophies]]
